description: 15 HTML style prompts. Each prompt is a self-contained user prompt that locks visual identity (typography + palette + layout sequence) so the same prompt produces visually consistent HTML across runs. Inject user content at {{CONTENT}}.

styles.name: Notion / Linear
styles.title: Notion / Linear
styles.summary: Three-column docs page with sidebar nav, light callouts, and a sticky TOC.
styles.prompt:
Generate a complete self-contained <!DOCTYPE html>...</html> page in **Notion / Linear documentation** style.

VIBE: Clean modern docs page — warm off-white canvas, left sidebar nav, center article, sticky right TOC.

LAYOUT (in this exact order):
1. Topbar 50px tall, white bg, 1px bottom border (--border), brand on left + search input right.
2. Three-column grid: 240px sidebar | 1fr article (max 720px) | 220px right TOC.
3. Sidebar group labels in 11px monospace uppercase muted; one active link uses accent background + white text.
4. Article: h1 36px, h2 22px, body 15–16px line-height 1.6.
5. One callout box with 3px left accent border, 8px radius, label "Note" in 11px uppercase accent.
6. One light code block: bg #f4f4f2, 8px radius, ui-monospace 13px.
7. Bottom pager: two outlined boxes (Previous / Next), flex space-between.

TYPOGRAPHY: -apple-system, system-ui, "Segoe UI", sans-serif. Code: ui-monospace, "JetBrains Mono".
PALETTE: --bg #fafaf9 --fg #1c1b1a --muted #6b6964 --border #e6e4e0 --accent #c96442 --code-bg #f4f4f2 --surface #ffffff.
DON'T: no Google Fonts, no card shadows (borders only), no dark code blocks, no hero, no second accent.

Output only the HTML.

CONTENT TO RENDER:
{{CONTENT}}
